package.name: raon_operator_gui
package.description: Desktop PyQt5 operator console for the KV260 pick&place pipeline. Runs on the desktop, not the board. Phase 1 is observe-only: it embeds the bbox-overlay video (same two-sided stamp join as detection_viewer_pkg) plus the live detections and the base_link pick target the robot app consumes. Run it INSTEAD OF detection_viewer_node — two subscribers double the board's JPEG egress.
